Aisha Patel: Quick heads up — Acme renewal runway. Need a 20m dry run tomorrow 10:30am PT. Tasks: slide owners, demo checklist, outstanding onboarding gaps, and a short risks page. Can ppl confirm owners?
Marcus Li: I can own the product/demo slides and run the demo. I'll need a clean staging dataset.
Samir Gupta: FYI there's one open data ingest ticket: `ACME-238` — still waiting on their SSO config. That blocks the live demo flow (token exchange).
Elena Ortiz: I’ll take the renewal risks slide and exec talking points. Who’s confirming exec attendees?
Aisha Patel: @Elena confirm please. Execs: CTO + Head of AI likely. If CTO attends we need a 1-min note on latency/cost improvements we shipped.
Marcus Li: Noted. For demo I need a canned prompt set + sample user data. Marcus Li: adding checklist here:
```
- staging dataset refreshed
- demo user created (email demo+1)
- model pinned to v2.1
- fallback route tested
```
Onboarding Bot: Reminder — action items assigned to Samir (ACME-238) and Marcus (demo prep) are due EOD today.
Samir Gupta: I pushed a short runbook to the account repo: `repos/acme/onboarding/runbook.md`. Current blocker is SSO config TTL with their infra. I pinged their eng: waiting on VPN cert rotation.
Elena Ortiz: Slide owners: Marcus (demo), Elena (exec + risk), Aisha (program overview). Can someone take the slide polish pass this afternoon?
Marcus Li: I can do a quick polish at 3pm PT. Posting deck link in convo — will update headliner slide and demo steps.
Aisha Patel: Great. Also capture feedback ask: 2 quick NPS-style Qs post-demo + list of missing integrations. Samir can we add a single slide that shows onboarding gaps and ETA?
Samir Gupta: Yep — will add gap slide with status bullets and ETA per item.
Elena Ortiz: I’ll draft the exec notes and a 3-bullet win slide (latency, cost, security).
Aisha Patel: Thanks all. TL;DR: dry run tomorrow 10:30am PT; owners confirmed (Marcus/demo, Elena/exec, Samir/gaps); Marcus to polish at 3pm PT; Samir to add gap slide; Onboarding Bot reminding due EOD. If anything slips tag me in thread. :thumbsup:
Marcus Li: 👍 will post updated deck link when done.
Onboarding Bot: ✅ Action summary sent to assignees via DM.
